shots.name: tests-gate-pass-fail
shots.caption: The tests gate run on tak 0.5.0: every assertion passes, then the same commit stops at `version` when 0.6.0 is expected.
shots.alt: Two terminal windows: the tests gate on tak prints five green PASS lines and exits 0; run again expecting 0.6.0 it prints PASS checkout, FAIL version and exits 1

shots.name: run-summary
shots.caption: What gates/summarize.py writes to the run summary for those two runs.
shots.alt: Two run-summary tables: Tests gate PASSED with five ticked assertions, and Tests gate FAILED with checkout ticked and version crossed

shots.name: save-compat-tak-pass
shots.caption: The save-compatibility gate: saves written by tak v0.2.0 are read, kept byte-identical and appended to by tak 0.5.0.
shots.alt: A terminal: the save-compatibility gate on tak exits 0 and its eleven assertions, from baseline-install to read-3, all print PASS
